# Pendo Analytics

Skills that teach agents to work with Pendo Analytics. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin](https://github.com/pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin), at commit `a0f8526`.

Bring Pendo analytics into Claude Code with skills for app health, account health, feature adoption, session replays, feedback analysis, and data-informed planning

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Pendo Analytics**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Pendo Analytics**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install pendo-analytics@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

6 skills: `account-health`, `app-health`, `data-informed-planning`, `feature-adoption`, `feedback-analysis`, `replay-triage`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
